*Vedanāttika, Vipākattika* (Patthana 11.11) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within the structural taxonomy of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text treats the analytical intersection of the feeling triad (*vedanāttika*) and the resultant triad (*vipākattika*) [SuttaCentral].
No curated parallels or cross-language alignments with Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan corpora are recorded [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Computational analysis via DharmaNexus identifies internal Pali text reuse comprising 17 matching passages across six other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. Its most prominent textual overlaps occur with *Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 11.10, particularly segments §1.1–2.1 aligning with §6.1–8.1) and *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 13.2, matching §0.2–1.1 with §0.2–1.1_1) [DharmaNexus]. Additional shared phrasing is found in *Sanidassanattika, Saññojanagocchakādi* (Patthana 22.31), *Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.21), *Piṭṭhiduka, Sanidassanattika* (Patthana 21.55), and *Tika Kusalattika* (Patthana 5.2) [DharmaNexus].
